verdict.rationale: Modal's first-party docs describe Sandboxes as "secure containers for executing untrusted user or agent code" (confirmed by probe). They are presented as ephemeral, isolated environments for running AI-generated code, with an agent example built on them. The docs also show concrete containment controls: `block_network`, outbound CIDR/domain allowlists, inbound allowlists, and per-sandbox CPU/memory settings. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary's strength, and documentation in the pack of the underlying isolation mechanism (VM Sandboxes are only Beta).
